# Synthetic Massive fixtures

Hand-written. They copy the **shape** of Massive's documented responses, but
every number is made up.

Massive's terms forbid publishing their data, and anyone this repo is shared
with (it was public until 2026-09-24) can read its history. So real
responses are never committed here. They stay in the gitignored `cache/` folder
on the machine that fetched them.
